subject: Money
title: Japan's Lost Decades
description: A quick win: understand Japan's Lost Decades.

hook.text: Japan's stock market peaked in 1989. Thirty-four years later, in 2023, it still hadn't fully recovered.

buildup.text: In the 1980s, Japan's economy was booming. Real estate in Tokyo was worth more than all of California.

discovery.text: The bubble burst in 1991. Prices collapsed, banks failed, and consumers stopped spending for a generation.

twist.text: Japan tried everything: zero rates, massive spending, quantitative easing. Nothing could revive consumer confidence.

climax.text: Deflation became self-reinforcing. People expected prices to fall, so they didn't spend, so prices fell further.

punchline.text: The richest country spent 30 years going nowhere.

quiz.question: When did Japan's asset bubble burst?
